short_description: Standalone evolutionary ecosystem research: grow ecology from landscape/history without player or biome species tables, then later transfer and continue the same ecology inside the world simulator.
purpose: Build a reusable autonomous evolutionary ecology mini-project that evolves plant and later multi-trophic ecosystems from causal environment/resource/competition/history rules, exports portable spatial ecology state, and eventually feeds World Generation/local/background simulation without duplicate ecology truth.
current_stage: ECO.EVO0 / CAL1-D Implemented Candidate / Exact Windows Lifecycle Gate
progress_note: CAL1-C is accepted with aggregate d48919f42e2da92d32b3cbb8b344cb4ba0a2357411707781725a6873f40c3f1a. CAL1-D implementation head 88adcc609fdfbc5511dc2aa0a4b779edc9a114e0 adds separate lifecycle observables for maturity, reserve-constrained reproduction, release-height dispersal, maturity timing, structural amortization, disturbance survival and recovery. CAL1-D deliberately exposes a vector of causal observables and does not create a combined lifecycle fitness score or tune coefficients. Exact Windows evidence is required before CAL1-D acceptance or CAL1-E execution.
next_stage: Run RUN_ECO_CAL1_D_TESTS.ps1 on exact Windows checkout. Require parent C preservation, maturity/reserve reproduction controls, release-height dispersal, growth/maturity timing, lifespan structural amortization, disturbance survival/recovery controls and fresh-process aggregate equality.
